ADR0038 replaces known-corrupt in-place repair with immediate stop, preserved source, typed untrusted salvage, fresh verified restore/merge and activation; explicit git_only/paired scope.

Document metadata filters preserve unknown/conflict gaps even if output is empty; exact Provider path/commit document selectors work without native byte availability, while incomplete current listings remain scoped gaps.
